summary: Reduced sorries in nf_characterizable_by_stavi from 2 to 1 by diagnosing and fixing a fundamental formula bug. The prior nf_succ_sf formula used nf_exist_sf with sf_top guard, which made the formula unable to distinguish 2-variable NFs sharing the same atom assignment. This caused both sorries to be on FALSE statements. Fix: replaced the proof to use classically-chosen existence formulas (nf_2var_existence_characterizable), consolidating 2 false-sorries into 1 true-sorry. The remaining sorry asserts that for each 2-variable depth-k NF, a StaviFormula exists characterizing its realizability -- a correct claim following from GHR93 Proposition 7 (game composition).
blocking_issues: nf_2var_existence_characterizable (1 sorry): requires connecting the game infrastructure (ghr93_strategy_compose, ghr93_game_iff_decomposition) to the NF-level existence characterization. The game infrastructure is sorry-free but operates on ExtendedCarrier/rank_type, not NormalForm/nf_eval_nf.
continuation_context: The single remaining sorry is nf_2var_existence_characterizable at line 1865 of StaviCompleteness.lean. Its goal: for each sub_nf : NormalForm sig k 2 and parent atom assignment, there exists a StaviFormula sf such that sf holds at t iff some x realizes sub_nf relative to t. This is GHR93's core existence claim. Proof requires: (1) building a formula using IH char_k formulas + proper interval guard in Until/Since that encodes the full 2-variable NF (not just atoms), and (2) showing the backward direction via the game-theoretic argument that interval type profiles determine multi-variable NFs. The game infrastructure in Composition.lean and Decomposition.lean provides the tools but the bridge to NF equality is missing.
